context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 tested the Credit-Aware AI Draft System. Key features: (1) Admin users have unlimited AI drafts - they see AI Draft button and Settings gear but NOT credits badge or Buy Credits button. (2) Free users see NONE of the AI Draft UI elements. (3) Paid non-admin users (starter/pro) would see credits badge, Buy Credits button, Settings gear, and AI Draft buttons - they need outreach_config set and credits > 0 to generate drafts. (4) Settings modal has 8 fields: product_name, target_audience, value_prop (required), tone (dropdown), custom_closing, product_url, sender_name, and Save Settings button. (5) Credits checkout creates Stripe session with metadata product=ai_draft_credits for webhook processing. (6) Webhook adds 500 credits on checkout.session.completed. All 11 backend tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass.
